title: CBPR+ SR2026 Structured Address Pre-Flight
description: Classify each party and agent postal address in a CBPR+ payment message as structured, hybrid, or unstructured per message type. Flags addresses Swift will hard-reject at CBPR+ network level from 14 November 2026, per the message-type exemption list, hybrid definition, and agent BIC-only rule published in Swift's CBPR+ SR2026 guidance. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

parties.description: Debtor, Creditor, Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent, and any Intermediary Agents, each with either a BIC-only flag or Town Name / Country / optional Post Code / up to 2 Address Lines

verdicts.description: Per-party verdict: PASS-structured, PASS-hybrid, PASS-exempt, or FAIL-reject, with missing-field list and hybrid rendering where applicable

mcp_tool_definition.name: cbpr_sr2026_address_preflight
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classify CBPR+ payment message postal addresses (debtor, creditor, debtor agent, creditor agent, intermediary agents) as structured, hybrid, or unstructured per Swift CBPR+ SR2026 guidance, and flag which will be hard-rejected at CBPR+ network level from 14 November 2026. camt.052/053/054/025/060 and admi.024 are exempt. Hybrid = Town Name + Country plus up to 2 Address Lines of up to 70 characters. Agents identified by BIC only need no postal address. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/632-cbpr-sr2026-address-preflight.html for interactive use.
